definition: Every time, or at all times.
exampleSentence: My father always drinks coffee before he reads the news.
I usually walk to work when the weather is nice.
We often eat dinner together on Sunday evenings.

definition: On some occasions but not always.
exampleSentence: Sometimes the bus is late, so I leave home early.
My brother rarely watches television because he prefers books.
I have never seen snow in my hometown.

definition: Before now or before a certain time.
exampleSentence: The movie had already started when we arrived at the cinema.
It is midnight, but my neighbors are still playing loud music.

definition: Until now (used in questions and negatives).
exampleSentence: I have not finished reading the book you gave me yet.

definition: A very short time ago, or only.
exampleSentence: I have just sent you the files by email.

definition: In a short time from now.
exampleSentence: The doctor will see you soon, so please take a seat.
I have three meetings and a dentist appointment today.
The new software version will be released tomorrow morning.
We had a team dinner at an Italian restaurant yesterday.
Please leave your coat here and follow me to the office.
We visited Paris last summer and loved every day we spent there.
The whole team worked together to finish the project on time.
The website crashed, so I had to fill in the form again.
It is almost nine o'clock, and the shop is about to close.

definition: Fairly, or more than a little.
exampleSentence: The exam was quite difficult, but I think I passed.
Thank you, this chocolate cake you made is really delicious.
The new office is very close to the train station.

definition: More than is good, or also.
exampleSentence: This jacket is too small for me, so I need a bigger size.
She plays the piano and also sings in a local choir.

definition: No more than; no one or nothing else.
exampleSentence: There is only one bathroom in our small apartment.
Maybe we can meet for coffee after work on Thursday.
It will probably rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
The fire spread quickly through the dry forest.
The old man walked slowly across the busy street.

definition: With attention, to avoid mistakes or danger.
exampleSentence: Read the contract carefully before you sign it.
You can easily change the font size in the settings menu.

definition: In a good or skillful way.
exampleSentence: She speaks Spanish well because she lived in Madrid for years.

definition: After a long time or delay.
exampleSentence: After two hours of waiting, our food finally arrived.
The lights suddenly went out during the storm last night.
I recently started taking guitar lessons on Saturday mornings.
Have you ever tried real Japanese food in Tokyo before?

definition: One time, or at some time in the past.
exampleSentence: I go to the gym once a week, usually on Mondays.
I am busy right now, but I can call you later.
Please turn off your phones now because the film is starting.

definition: Used to show that something is surprising.
exampleSentence: My grandmother even knows how to use video calls on her tablet.
